artworks.title: Recumbent Goats
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two goats lying on the ground with a small wooden structure in the background. The scene depicts a rustic landscape with two goats in the foreground. The goat on the left has curved horns and looks directly at the viewer, while a smaller goat lies beside it. In the background, a cart or wooden wagon is seen on a slight rise of earth. The sky has softly drawn clouds, creating a tranquil atmosphere. The drawing uses fine line work to detail the fur of the goats and the landscape.

artworks.title: Peasants Lunching in Open Air
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five men around a small table outdoors. Their distinct features and clothing typical of the time are visible. They are seated on makeshift stools, with two men standing and conversing. In the background, more people are gathered around a village fair or market, with a tall church steeple in the distance.

artworks.title: Air
artworks.artist: Jan van de Velde II after Willem Buytewech
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting a rural scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon line is relatively high in the composition, featuring distant figures and a settlement with a church steeple. The engraved lines provide detailed textures to elements like a thatched roof and a large tree. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on a light background emphasizing contrast. Closest to the viewer, figures are engaged in activities like hunting with falcons. Further back, a group of animals pulls a cart near more figures, and in the distance, people are working on and around a raised mound.

artworks.title: Water
artworks.artist: Jan van de Velde II after Willem Buytewech
artworks.description: There is a drawing of a group of individuals near a coastal area with boats. The scene depicts people engaged in various activities, including conversations, carrying baskets, and tending to animals. In the background, a building or tower is visible, along with boats on the water. The foreground shows fish on the ground and a fire pit. The image is rich in texture, with hatching and cross-hatching techniques used for detail. Written text is seen at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Fire
artworks.artist: Jan van de Velde II after Willem Buytewech
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene from a side view perspective, showing a group of people engaging in various activities along a dock or riverside. A wooden crane-like structure is visible, along with other architectural elements like barrels and buildings. The style uses fine lines and cross-hatching for detail and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and white. In the background, smoke rises, and a small group of people is seen in the distance.

artworks.title: Earth
artworks.artist: Jan van de Velde II after Willem Buytewech
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people engaged in various activities in a rural setting. The scene features figures carrying baskets on their heads, interacting with animals and each other, along with baskets and barrels filled with produce. In the background, there are buildings and arches, suggesting a village or farm setting. Trees, fields, and a softly rendered sky with clouds can be seen on the horizon. The artwork employs fine linework and hatching with a monochromatic palette to emphasize texture and form. The depiction captures a detailed view of rural life with a bustling community set against a harmonious backdrop of natural landscape and architecture.

artworks.title: Death Taking a Couple by Surprise
artworks.description: The image contains two individuals and a skeletal figure in an interior space. The person on the left is seated at a table, holding a goblet. They have an intricate hairstyle and ornate clothing. The second person stands next to them, holding a cup. They have short, textured hair and wear elegant attire. Behind them is a skeletal figure holding an hourglass in one hand and resting the other on the second person's shoulder. The background shows a landscape with trees and architectural elements. In the foreground, there are various items on a table, including vessels, books, and a sheathed sword.

artworks.title: Two Figures in Costume
artworks.description: The image shows two people standing. The person on the left is standing in profile with their right hand leaning against a doorway. They have short hair under a tall hat and are wearing a cloak, a collared shirt, puffed breeches, and buckled shoes. The person on the right is facing forward, wearing a broad ruffled collar, a long gown fitted at the waist, and a bonnet. They appear to be gesturing slightly with their hands at their sides. The intricate line work depicts a home interior or exterior near a wooden door with foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Two Figures in Costume
artworks.description: The image depicts a man and a woman standing close together. The woman has her hair up, with a visible hairline and delicate facial features. She is wearing a high-collared ruffled dress with long sleeves. The man has shoulder-length hair and wears a hat, with defined features and a neutral expression. He is dressed in a long coat with a cape-like garment. The woman appears to be holding her dress, while the man has one arm behind her and another at his side. In the background, there are trees, a structure in the distance, a textured wall, and a column. The sky is partially cloudy with a few birds flying.

artworks.title: Two Figures in Costume
artworks.description: The image shows two people standing next to each other. The person on the left has their hands on their hips, while the person on the right has their right arm crossed over their chest. The person on the left has a round face with delicate features, a ruffled collar, a bonnet, and an elaborate gown. The gown has long sleeves, a high neckline, and a voluminous skirt with intricate patterns and a large floral embellishment. The person on the right has a long hat with a wide brim, covering part of their face. They wear a cape over one shoulder and a layered outfit with stockings and pointed shoes. The background features a brick or stone structure, a large building with a hipped roof in the distance, trees, and possibly a low wall.

artworks.title: Two Figures in Costume
artworks.description: Two individuals are shown standing side by side, facing the viewer. The person on the left has a serene expression and delicate features. Their hair is styled in an upward manner, possibly under a headdress, adorned with a flower. They wear a long dress with a detailed pattern. The individual on the right has longer hair flowing from under a tall hat with decorative elements. They wear voluminous garments, including a cape and knee-length trousers with bows on the shoes. Both have ruffled collars. Each holds a piece of cloth or garment. In the background, there is a building, trees, and a large decorative column.

artworks.title: Two Figures in Costume
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body depictions of a woman and a man standing side by side. The woman is on the left, turned towards the man, with her body slightly angled. She wears a headpiece and a voluminous garment with a high collar and puffed sleeves. The man on the right faces forward and wears a fitted tunic with a fur collar, a short cape, and tights. They are standing in a setting with architectural elements visible in the background.

artworks.title: Two Figures in Costume
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a woman and a man. The woman stands with her hands clasped in front of her, facing forward. She wears a detailed dress and a decorative headdress. The man stands beside her, looking at her. He has styled hair and wears a tall hat, a long coat, wide breeches, and bow shoes. The background includes columns and a landscape with buildings and trees, suggesting an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Two Figures in Costume
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a man and a woman, standing together. The woman on the left has her hands on her waist, facing forward and smiling. She wears a dress with a high ruffled collar and long fitted sleeves. Her hair is styled around a circular headpiece. The man on the right is gesturing with his right hand, holding a hat under his left arm. He has shoulder-length, wavy hair and a small mustache, wearing a coat, knee-length trousers, long stockings, and shoes with bows. Behind them is an ornate column, a window ledge with two potted plants, and an outdoor scene visible through the window. The background has a textured hatching pattern.

artworks.title: Two Figures in Costume
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals, a man and a woman. The woman stands facing slightly to the left, with her head tilted towards the viewer. She is wearing a dress with a high ruffled collar, adorned with patterns, and holds a fan in her right hand. The man stands to her right, also facing the same direction but slightly turned towards the woman. He wears a tall hat, a cloak, knee-length pants, and bow shoes. The background shows trees, a distant house or castle-like structure, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Ferdinand II
artworks.artist: Pieter van Sompel after Pieter Claesz Soutman
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a bust-length portrait of a man with detailed facial features, including a high forehead, arched eyebrows, large round eyes, a pointed nose, a mustache, and a small beard. His hair is short and dark, combed back. He wears ornate attire with a ruffled collar, intricate patterns, a chain across his chest, and formal decorations. The background features an elaborate frame with carvings of floral motifs, an eagle holding a shield, and fruit and foliage. A scroll with decorative script is at the bottom of the frame.

artworks.title: Amelia Elizabeth, Countess of Hesse
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman from the shoulders up. She is facing slightly to her left, with a calm expression. She has long, curly hair and is dressed in attire with a high collar and a dark bow at the neckline, as well as a draped garment with wide sleeves. The background is plain with a curved border, and the bottom of the portrait includes a dedication with the name "Amelia Elisabetha, D.G. Hassiae Landgravia" and additional titles.

artworks.title: Pieter Bruegel the Younger
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing a man seated in a relaxed position. He has a broad forehead, pronounced brows, deep-set eyes, and a full beard and mustache. His hair is short and wavy. He is wearing an elaborate ruffled collar and a garment with round buttons. There are no visible accessories or objects in his hands. The background is plain, with some lines suggesting a chair or furnishing behind him.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.7 x 15.3 cm (9 5/16 x 6 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person's upper body. The shoulders are faintly sketched while the head is fully rendered. The person is in a three-quarter view, looking over their left shoulder towards the viewer. The facial features are distinct with a mustache and a focused expression. The person's hair is curly and medium length, framing the face. There are no specific clothing details. The background is simple and unadorned, with the focus being on the person's head and facial expression.

artworks.title: Erasmus of Rotterdam
artworks.artist: Sir Anthony van Dyck after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching of a man shown from the waist up, seated and turned slightly to his right. His head is oriented towards the left, giving a side-profile view. He has a distinguished facial structure with a long face, deep-set eyes, and notable cheekbones. The man is wearing a voluminous cloak or robe that drapes around his shoulders, and a hat with a soft brim that fits snugly on his head. His hair is curly and styled into loose waves. His hands, which appear to be holding a book, are partially visible in front of him. The background is plain, emphasizing the intricate line work and shading of the etching. The image shows signs of aging with subtle marks and textures on the surface.

artworks.title: Frans Francken II
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man, depicting his upper body from the waist up. He is seated, with his right hand resting on his chest. The man has distinctive facial features, including a full beard and mustache, and wavy hair that recedes slightly. His expression is neutral and focused. He is wearing a long cloak with a visible collar and a buttoned garment underneath. The background is a simple, etched pattern, and the setting is minimal, emphasizing the subject of the portrait. At the bottom of the image, there is a signature written in a cursive style.

artworks.title: Jodocus de Momper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraved portrait of a man's upper body. He is positioned at a three-quarter angle, with his head turned slightly towards the viewer, displaying his facial features. The man appears aged and wise, with distinct lines on his face, a prominent nose, and a groomed curled mustache. His hair is closely cropped, and he wears a cloak over his shoulders and a garment with buttons. His hand is raised, with no visible object. The background outlines mountainous terrain, and the name "Jodocus de Momper" is inscribed at the bottom.

artworks.title: Jodocus de Momper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of an elderly man in a slight profile view. He has distinctive features including a long mustache, a full beard, short wavy hair, and is wearing a shirt and cloak. His hands are raised slightly in front of him. The background features mountainous scenery, a castle-like structure, and a textured vertical form on the left. The image is created in a classic etching style with intricate line work.

artworks.title: Paulus Pontius
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a person from the waist up, positioned in a three-quarter view facing to the right. The person has curly hair, a mustache, distinct facial features including prominent eyes, and a strong gaze directed to the side. They wear a garment with buttons down the front and a ruffled collar, with draped fabric across the shoulders and extending downward. The etching highlights the texture and folds of the clothing. The person's hands are resting at waist level, and there is no visible jewelry. The background has a finely lined texture with no discernible objects, emphasizing the figure as the central focus.
